title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Completed the porous medium traveling wave research task. Implemented analytical and adaptive numerical methods to solve the traveling-wave ODE reduction of the porous medium equation. Achieved L2 residual of ~10^-17, far exceeding the target tolerance of 10^-8. Generated 5 figures showing wave profiles, residuals, convergence, parameter effects, and adaptive refinement. Produced comprehensive report at report/report.md with methodology, results, and discussion.
